import sys, os; sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
for k in ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY', 'PLACE_MODEL']: os.environ.pop(k, None)
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/worktrees/send-c1b/backend')
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
from dealroom_sign import placement
from dealroom_sign.tests import placement_r24_review_cases as R24
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement import TWO
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement_r14 import in_process
rc = R24.rc; print(placement.VERSION)
PAT = dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.PE)
FPAT = dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.DE, company='Fleet Test Co.', side='us')
fleet = R24.company_block('DISCLOSER:', 'FLEET TEST CO.', 40)
aff = R24.company_block(None, 'HARBOR LIGHT GROUP, INC.', 40, 500)
sub = lambda rows, old, new: [(r[0], new, False, r[3]) if r[1] == old else r for r in rows]
own_a = sub(sub(R24.company_block('RECIPIENT:', 'HL ANALYTICS, INC.', 320), 'Name:', 'Name: Pat Smith'), 'Title:', 'Address: 100 Harbor Way')
CASES = [('A address', [list(rc.RECITALS['parsed']), fleet + own_a + aff], [PAT]),
         ('A address both', [list(rc.RECITALS['parsed']), fleet + own_a + aff], [TWO[1], PAT]),
         ('B shared name', [list(rc.RECITALS['parsed']), sub(fleet, 'Name:', 'Name: Pat Smith') + R24.company_block('THE SUPPLIER', None, 320) + aff], [FPAT, PAT]),
         ('B shared name hl', [list(rc.RECITALS['parsed']), sub(fleet, 'Name:', 'Name: Pat Smith') + R24.company_block('RECIPIENT:', 'HL ANALYTICS, INC.', 320) + aff], [FPAT, PAT])]
X = 72
for cap in ('Executed by:', 'Authorised signatory:', 'Signatory:', 'Firma:', 'Unterschrift:'):
    for head in ('For and on behalf of the Recipient', 'harbor light analytics, inc.'):
        rows = [(240, 'FLEET TEST CO.', False, X), (270, 'By:', True, X), (300, 'Date:', True, X), (340, head, False, X),
                (370, cap, True, X), (382, 'Name: Pat Smith', False, X), (420, 'Date:', True, X),
                (520, 'HARBOR LIGHT GROUP, INC.', False, X), (560, 'By:', True, X), (600, 'Date:', True, X)]
        CASES.append(('B-2 '+cap+' | '+head, [list(rc.RECITALS['parsed']), rows], [PAT]))
http = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('http'))
with patch('httpx.Client.send', http):
    for name, pages, people in CASES:
        pdf = rc.pages_pdf(pages); mo = Mock()
        r = placement.place(pdf, people, model_client=mo)
        print(name, len(people), r['status'], r.get('reason_code'), [(f['signer'].split('@')[0], f['type'], f['evidence']['line'], f['confidence']) for f in r['fields']], 'model', mo.call_count, 'eq', r == in_process(placement, pdf, people, Mock()))
print('http', http.call_count)
